verdict.rationale: Bun documents a `--frozen-lockfile` flag for reproducible installs: it installs the exact lockfile versions and does not update the lockfile. That covers the frozen-lockfile mode itself. The evidence does not say the install fails with an error when package.json and bun.lock disagree, which is the enforcement part of the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation that frozen mode errors out on a manifest/lockfile mismatch, CI-oriented enforcement details (e.g. a config or env default), independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce a frozen/immutable lockfile mode that fails the install when the manifest and lockfile disagree

citations.quote: For reproducible installs, use `--frozen-lockfile`. Bun installs the exact versions specified in the lockfile and does not update it.
